documents.text: To reset your password, choose Forgot password on the sign-in page and follow the reset link sent to your email.
To change the email address on your account, update it from your profile settings and verify the new address.
To track a purchase, open Orders in your account and select the order to view its current delivery status.
Orders can be cancelled from the order details page before the seller begins processing them.
Your available wallet balance is displayed in the Wallet section of your account.
Add funds to your Cartord wallet from Wallet by choosing Add funds and completing payment.
Start a return from order details, choose the item and reason, and follow the return instructions.
Sellers can manage stock quantities and availability from the inventory section of the seller dashboard.
